purpose: Qualify a committed-PC ROI by its exact lane endpoint equation instead of requiring equal start and end lanes.

scope.applicability: Only receipts that explicitly bind this amendment and satisfy every proof obligation may use endpoint-corrected baseline qualification.

supersedes.amended_rule: baseline qualification requires the exact endpoint-corrected capacity and does not require start_lane == end_lane

preserves: all cycle, slot, head, memory and request-detail conservation rules
all overflow, invalid-event, complete, available and unknown-ratio gates
normative_precedence.precedence_rule: This amendment overrides only the two named phase-alignment qualification clauses; all other bound contract and schema clauses remain normative.

qualification_rule.phase_aligned: int(start_lane == end_lane); retained as an observed diagnostic, not a qualification gate

proof_obligations: the BOUNDARY start/end markers are unique and bind the policy start/stop PCs
FINAL is unique, complete, successful and exactly matches both boundary deltas
COUNTERS_FINAL is unique, complete, available, non-overflowing and has zero invalid events
COUNTERS_FINAL start_lane/end_lane/phase_aligned match the boundary markers
retired_slots equals retired instructions and unused_slots equals slot_capacity - retired_slots
primary cycle and slot ledgers conserve exactly
head, memory and memory-request nested aggregates conserve exactly
unknown or unclassified cycle ratio remains within the bound measurement contract
all required repetitions are bit-exact without outlier removal

rationale.root_cause: The v4 schema already defines and emits exact endpoint correction, while its baseline qualifier separately required equal lanes. That qualifier rejects a mathematically conserved lane1-to-lane0 committed-PC interval.
rationale.safety_property: The amendment removes no conservation or identity check and grants no tolerance; it replaces an equality proxy with the exact two-lane interval equation.
non_claims: no benchmark, ROI PC, image, simulator, configuration or latency change
